question: Will Kendrick Lamar release a new album before Dec 31, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Kendrick Lamar officially releases a new studio album, mixtape, or commercial project credited to him as a lead artist on any major music platform or through any label/distributor, strictly after 2026-10-09T11:39:12.055Z and at or before 2026-12-31T00:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if no such release occurs strictly after 2026-10-09T11:39:12.055Z and at or before 2026-12-31T00:00:00.000Z.

Clarifications:
- "New album" means a previously unreleased full-length studio album, mixtape, or equivalent commercial project (EP or compilation albums do not qualify) for which Kendrick Lamar is the primary credited artist; standalone singles, guest features, and soundtrack contributions where he is not the lead/sole artist do not qualify.
